caption_argument_segments: Line items shipped? Orders fully complete? Value delivered? On time by whose clock, yours or the customer's?
The metric you choose changes the story entirely. Here are 3 supply chain KPIs I've been learning about that are easy to track wrong:

1. On-Time In-Full (OTIF) Most teams track "on-time" OR "in-full" separately. OTIF combines both, an order is only a win if it arrives complete AND on schedule. Tracking them apart hides the real fill rate problem.

2. Inventory Turnover A high turnover ratio looks healthy. But if you're turning inventory fast because you're constantly running lean and expediting orders, that's a cost problem disguised as a performance win.
